note.en: Analytic reference Periodic [0,2π]²; unit density; viscosity 0.1; zero mean pressure. Web profile is an x-slice at y=π/4. Taylor–Green: x-slice at y = π/4. The analytic model shares ν=0.1 and periodic [0,2π]², but the card displays an x-slice at y=π/4, not full 2D velocity/pressure or mesh-error arrays.
